main.description: Remove an indexed community by its DID as one instance decision and publish a !takedown label on the community DID. Removing a community that is already removed is unchanged. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed, including a subject that is not a DID; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The DID is not an indexed community; do not retry.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is stale, or the DID has an account ban in force (lift it with unbanAccount first); refetch getSubjectState before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: UnsupportedReason
errors.description: The reason is not supported for this action; choose a supported reason before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

subject.description: DID of the indexed community to remove; any other DID is refused with InvalidSubject

expectedVersion.description: Opaque subject-state version of at://<subject> expected by the caller

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes equivalent removal requests idempotent

reason.description: Public reason classification for removing the community

privateNote.description: Private administrative note retained only on the admin action
